summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K (home-country equivalent of a US current report) announcing weekly share repurchases under its existing buyback program. During September 28-October 2, 2026, the company repurchased 9,370,000 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 93.0880, for total consideration of SEK 872,234,451.60. The program, of up to SEK 15 billion, runs April 23, 2026 through March 31, 2027 and is executed by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm under the EU MAR safe harbor. Treasury stock now totals 117,888,663 Class B shares. Watch for cancellation approval at the 2027 AGM.
